facts.summary: FDA safety concerns ended program; company starts strategic review · Phase 1b · pociredir in sickle cell disease · not yet approved

evidence.summary: FDA considered this position but concluded that any pharmacological intervention targeting the PRC2 complex carries equivalent malignancy risk regardless of the specific subunit engaged.
evidence.safety: Across the 12 mg and 20 mg dose cohorts, pociredir has been generally well-tolerated with up to three months of exposure, with no treatment-related serious adverse events reported.
evidence.program_discontinued: today announced the discontinuation of its pociredir program for the treatment of SCD and the initiation of a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives to maximize stockholder value.
